definitions.explanation: The act of secretly listening to a conversation that is not intended for you to hear.

examples.japanese: {盗|ぬす}み{聞|ぎ}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Eavesdropping is not a good thing to do.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盗|ぬす}み{聞|ぎ}き⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally overheard the conversation in the next room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てて→当てる：01864_ateru⟧{盗|ぬす}み{聞|ぎ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つかって→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧、⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦{怒|おこ}られた→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: I was caught eavesdropping with my ear against the wall and got severely scolded.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{盗|ぬす}む→盗む：01166_nusumu⟧ (to steal) and ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen), with rendaku changing き to ぎ. Literally means "stealing a listen." The verb form is {盗|ぬす}み{聞|ぎ}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盗|ぬす}み{聞|ぎ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to eavesdrop
- {盗|ぬす}み{聞|ぎ}き⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be eavesdropped on
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盗|ぬす}み{聞|ぎ}き: phone tapping

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{盗|ぬす}み{見|み}→盗み見：26023_nusumimi⟧: peeping, peeking — the visual equivalent, secretly watching
- {盗聴|とうちょう}: wiretapping, bugging — a more technical/legal term for electronic eavesdropping
- {立|た}ち{聞|ぎ}き: overhearing while standing nearby — less intentional than {盗|ぬす}み{聞|ぎ}き
